newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Bel-20 firm, Petrofina seen supported ahead warrant.
newsitem.headline: Bel-20 firm, Petrofina seen supported ahead warrant.

text.p: Belgian shares opened slightly lower on Friday, following the market's closure on Thursday, but a string of dividend payments was easily digested.

The Bel-20 index -- which should have lost 13.54 points as shares of BBL, CBR, CMB, Cobepa, Cofinnimmo, Generale Bank and Gevaert went ex-dividend -- stood just 1.89 point lower at 2232.86 after 45 minutes of trade.
Volume was a hefty 1.5 billion francs, boosted by a string of pre-opening cross trades by institutionals in shares of Generale Bank, Kredietbank, CBR Delhaize and Electrabel.
For the rest of the day, trade is seen very quiet.
